_written: 2026-10-14, BEFORE any gen45 number was computed (DVOL endpoint probed for availability only).
idea: crypto volatility risk premium: implied vol (Deribit DVOL, 30d) exceeds subsequently realised vol on average -> selling 30-day variance earns a steady monthly premium (with crash/tail risk). Own Deribit account only; NOT tradable at CFT.
data: Deribit DVOL daily (BTC, ETH) 2021-03..2026-10; realised vol from Binance spot daily closes (static_klines), annualised sqrt(365)
rule V1 (fixed): on the first day of each month: sell a 30-day variance-swap proxy per coin; P&L (fraction of capital) = vega_budget x (IV_eff^2 - RV_30^2) / (2 x IV_eff), IV_eff = DVOL_entry - 1.5 vol points (bid/ask + hedging costs), vega_budget = 0.5% of capital per vol point per coin; RV_30 = realised vol over the next 30 days
gates ('STEADY VRP'): TEST: share of positive months >= 0.70, monthly Sharpe (annualised) >= 1.0, worst month > -3 x mean month; ALL: same sign
report: tail: worst months, behaviour in 2022 (LUNA/FTX), combination with C*
